name: Hold Button
description: A button that only fills while held; releasing early empties it, and the fill edge advances with a water ripple.
interactionNotes: Hold the button so it fills from one edge; releasing before it finishes empties it with the same ease, and a release under 250 milliseconds counts as a tap. Space and Enter also start holding, and Escape cancels. The pointer leaving or the window being hidden also cancels, so nothing is half-confirmed. After completion the label fades/blurs to "Deleted" and, if `resetAfter` is positive, the button returns to idle.

props.name: children
props.description: The button text in the normal state.

props.name: doneLabel
props.description: The button text after the hold completes.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional icon beside the normal text.

props.name: doneIcon
props.description: Optional icon beside the done text.

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Background of the button.

props.name: fillColor
props.description: Color of the fill and the glow.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Text color in the normal state.

props.name: fillTextColor
props.description: Text color over the filled part.

props.name: size
props.description: Height and font size: 36 / 44 / 52 pixels.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius, pixels.

props.name: fillDirection
props.description: Fill direction. In RTL, "right" is still the start edge and it does not flip.

props.name: holdTime
props.description: How many milliseconds to hold for confirmation.

props.name: releaseTime
props.description: Duration of emptying after release or when returning to idle.

props.name: pressScale
props.description: Button scale while holding with the pointer.

props.name: wave
props.description: Toggles the ripple on the fill edge.

props.name: waveAmplitude
props.description: Wave amplitude, pixels.

props.name: glow
props.description: Glow around the button while holding and when done.

props.name: resetAfter
props.description: How many milliseconds after confirming to return to idle; zero means never.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims and ignores input.

props.name: autoPreview
props.description: Site preview only: it runs the full hold-and-release cycle itself so the fill and the springy pop can be seen.

props.name: onHold
props.description: Called when the hold completes.

props.name: onTap
props.description: Called when the release came before 250 milliseconds (a tap).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class for the root element.

tips: Use `onHold` for the final action and `onTap` for a guidance message ("Hold to delete") — keep the two apart, and a tap never counts as confirmation.
Do not set `holdTime` shorter than 600ms; below that a tap and a hold cannot be told apart and the user deletes without meaning to. The component itself defaults to 2000ms.
If you want the button to stay on "Deleted" after confirming, pass `resetAfter={0}` — otherwise it returns to idle after 1200ms. For list rows, zero is usually the right choice.
In Persian the fill direction does not flip: `fillDirection="right"` fills from the start edge of the sentence, which is what a Persian reader's eye expects; use "up" for tall and narrow buttons.

The screen-reader text is generated automatically from `holdTime` ("Hold for 2 seconds to confirm") and announced with Persian digits; for actions other than delete, change `children` and `doneLabel` — you do not need to supply the assistive text by hand.
With `prefers-reduced-motion` the ripple and pulse turn off and the fill is shown only by a change in opacity; the hold logic and timing stay untouched.
